title: Social Media Scams Cause $2.1B in Losses in 2025
discussion_signal: The post and replies interpret social media as a distribution and accountability problem rather than only a consumer-education problem. Discussion points to platform reach, Meta concentration, investment and shopping scams, and the gap between reported loss and platform responsibility.
linked_research_question: How do public discussions connect social-platform distribution, scam exposure, underreporting, and responsibility for consumer recourse?
limits: Replies are not a representative victim or platform-user sample
Reported losses do not establish total fraud incidence
Public search discovery is not a platform-native Creator/API export
